title: Audit des écarts prioritaires pour l'optimisation complète du générateur

priorities.currentEvidence: 71/493 canonical species covered; 422 absent from runtime roster.
nextActions: Review candidate profile names/IDs/types/stats and exceptions against ROM-specific raw records.
Integrate in batches with assertions preventing CPUF/CPUE data mixing.
Test every supported species in the team builder and the 6-Pokémon team constraints.
priorities.exitCriteria: 493 standard species covered or exclusions explicitly documented; zero duplicate IDs, missing profiles, invalid stats, or cross-ROM leakage.

priorities.currentEvidence: 471 shared move IDs, 101 raw records differ; 8 CPUE moves use raw type ID 9; effects remain uncertified.
nextActions: Decode the CPUF and CPUE name tables independently for every move ID.
Cross-reference type/category/power/accuracy/PP/effect/target/priority/flags.
Trace CPUE battle handlers or obtain runtime evidence for changed effect IDs; keep unknown effects blocked.
priorities.exitCriteria: Each selectable move has ROM-specific identity and fields; changed CPUE effects certified or explicitly unavailable.

priorities.currentEvidence: 493 standard species rows audited per ROM; 6598 CPUF and 8590 CPUE level-up entries; matching numeric IDs are not semantic identity proof.
nextActions: Resolve move names per ROM before using learnset counts.
Compare level-up, TM/HM, tutor/egg sources if exported; label missing sources instead of assuming legality.
Separate competitive PKHeX custom moves from in-ROM learnset legality.
priorities.exitCriteria: Move source and ROM-specific identity documented for each proposed legal moveset.

priorities.currentEvidence: 446 CPUF item entries versus 470 CPUE entries; 165 shared-index item records differ and 24 CPUE-only entries.
nextActions: Decode names independently for each ROM.
Audit held effect, parameters, availability and Gen IV compatibility separately.
Block unknown/post-Gen-IV or mod-only items from default Gen IV recommendations.
priorities.exitCriteria: Items are whitelisted by ROM, effect evidence and user's Gen IV restrictions; no index-only assumptions.

priorities.currentEvidence: 124 CPUF ability names versus 127 CPUE; candidate roster does not certify ability names/effects.
nextActions: Decode ability names per ROM and map species ability slots.
Check Project PM runtime implementation of new/changed abilities.
Mark unverified ability effects and exclude from strategy scoring until confirmed.
priorities.exitCriteria: Ability names, slots and effects have ROM-specific provenance or explicit unknown status.

priorities.currentEvidence: Evolution tables differ (508 vs 509 entries); special entries and extra CPUE species require identity/semantics checks.
nextActions: Decode evolution method IDs/parameters against correct ROM rules.
Verify special species/forms and CPUE-only entry 508 without assuming national Pokédex identity.
Keep incomplete methods out of user-facing recommendations.
priorities.exitCriteria: Evolution requirements and special IDs are resolved or explicitly excluded.

priorities.currentEvidence: Candidate data is not full runtime integration; unknown semantics would distort synergy scores and recommendations.
nextActions: Make scoring consume only validated ROM-specific profiles and mechanics.
Add unit tests for double-battle synergy, duplicate types, starter trio, legendary count and alternate team mode.
Expose confidence/source markers for candidate or custom PKHeX movesets.
priorities.exitCriteria: Deterministic tests cover constraints, synergy and invalid/unknown data handling.

priorities.currentEvidence: Recent GitHub API checks returned no status checks/workflow runs; syntax was inspected but scripts were not executed in a Node runtime.
nextActions: Run npm/test scripts in a real Node environment.
Add/verify GitHub Actions workflow for audit validation and UI tests.
Record exact command, environment, commit and output.
priorities.exitCriteria: Automated tests pass on the exact commit; no claims of success without logs.

policies: Do not merge CPUF and CPUE records by numeric index without independent identity checks.
Type ID 9 means Fairy only for the exact Project PM CPUE ROM hash confirmed by the user; in CPUF it must retain canonical Gen IV semantics.
Candidate 493-species data is not runtime-integrated until validated.
Canonical effect symbols are hypotheses only until CPUE battle semantics are verified.
Do not treat PKHeX custom moves as in-ROM learnset legality.
All counts and conclusions are tied to the exact ROM hashes recorded in the source audits.
